## Activity

During May 2024, East City Eye Clinic recorded 226 captures. Activity was completed through the scheduled clinic sessions, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The volume reflects the activity submitted for review during the month. No additional activity is included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 226 captures, 6 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.7 per cent. The image-quality outcome should be considered alongside the total capture activity for the month. The ungradable captures were excluded from grading outcomes where image quality did not support a reliable assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 59 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 3 days. This provides the central measure of the time taken for images to proceed through the grading process during May 2024. Activity, image-quality findings and grading results are reported for East City Eye Clinic as part of routine site operations monitoring.
